items.claim: Alvarez relies on his opponent attempting a takedown so he can sweep or submit them.
items.quote: he's usually kind of relying on the other guy to take him down and then he'll [__] sweep or sub.

items.claim: Alvarez will struggle to convince Chidi to initiate a takedown.
items.quote: I don't think he's going to be able to convince Chidi to take him down.

items.claim: Chidi's takedown defense is not amazing.
items.quote: Chidi's takedown defense is is not amazing.

items.claim: Alvarez is skilled enough on the feet to mix it up, create a scramble, and secure a choke.
items.quote: I think Alvarez is good enough on the feet that he can kind of mix it up and create a scramble and then eventually sink a choke.

items.claim: Alvarez has only landed one takedown in his recent fights, which was against Luque.
items.quote: Alvarez, one takedown, it was against Luque, you know, two fights ago.
Chidi's got a little bit of uh firepower so like that could be a little scary

items.claim: Edson Barboza has accumulated 38 fights in his career, primarily in the UFC, and still makes the 155-pound limit.
items.quote: This dude has 38 fights in his career, most of them in the UFC, and he's he's still showing up, still making 155.

items.claim: Esteban Ribovics is an action fighter who walks forward throwing heavy punches.
items.quote: he's going to get a kid that's going to be walking towards him throwing hayes. Like this dude [__] like complete action fighter

items.claim: Edson Barboza still retains the power to clip an opponent who is walking forward.
items.quote: Can he still clip somebody? Yeah, like Edson can still clip somebody walking towards him throwing hayes.
